evidence.currentRole: https://chemistry.ujep.cz/odborni-asistenti/ lists her among Odborní asistenti (assistant professors), linked to the live individual profile. https://www.fzp.ujep.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/P%C5%99%C3%ADloha-3-Udr%C5%BEitelnost-obnoviteln%C3%BDch-zdroj%C5%AF-surovin-AS-F%C5%BDP.pdf (2025 accreditation submission, downloaded successfully and text-extracted in memory) states “2001–dosud– odborná asistentka katedry chemie UJEP”. Its personnel summary explicitly gives Nguyen, Thi Thu Huong, “PP 1,0 doba neurčitá” (full-time, indefinite employment), and the individual personnel sheet gives 40 hours. Course responsibility includes organic chemistry lectures and laboratory teaching. Teaching track reflects the documented permanent faculty teaching appointment; no tenure claim is inferred.
evidence.doctorateOrPapers: https://chemistry.ujep.cz/rndr-thu-huong-nguyen-thi-ph-d/ confirms organic chemistry studies at the Faculty of Science, Charles University, Prague, with PhD awarded in 1997. The same employer accreditation submission https://www.fzp.ujep.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/P%C5%99%C3%ADloha-3-Udr%C5%BEitelnost-obnoviteln%C3%BDch-zdroj%C5%AF-surovin-AS-F%C5%BDP.pdf gives Mgr. in organic chemistry (1992) and Ph.D. in organic chemistry (1997), both PřF UK Praha. It also lists her 2023 Molecules research article, DOI 10.3390/molecules28135231; eligibility uses the documented doctorate, not a two-paper inference.
evidence.vietnameseSignal: https://chemistry.ujep.cz/rndr-thu-huong-nguyen-thi-ph-d/ publishes the Vietnamese given-name tokens Thu Huong, with Nguyen Thi in its local display order. The employer accreditation personnel table https://www.fzp.ujep.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/P%C5%99%C3%ADloha-3-Udr%C5%BEitelnost-obnoviteln%C3%BDch-zdroj%C5%AF-surovin-AS-F%C5%BDP.pdf explicitly separates surname Nguyen from given names Thi Thu Huong, supporting the proposed First Middle Last display name. No diacritic Vietnamese name is inferred.
evidence.dedup: Ran npm run find-roster-matches -- "Thi Thu Huong Nguyen" --url https://chemistry.ujep.cz/rndr-thu-huong-nguyen-thi-ph-d/ https://chemistry.ujep.cz/odborni-asistenti/. Also searched the variants Thu Huong Nguyen Thi and Thu Huong Thi Nguyen. No identity-URL or retired-ID match. Name-only hits resolved as different people: vp-0251 (Michigan chemistry education, Michigan State doctorate), vp-0252 (Minnesota nursing, Chicago doctorate), vp-0476 (Utah philosophy), vp-0514 (McGill plant science, Iowa State doctorate), vp-1907 (Greenwich accounting/finance), vp-2029 (La Trobe management/HR, Melbourne doctorate), vp-3134 (Insmed computational biology, Stony Brook doctorate), vp-3200 (Triple Ring medical-device R&D, Stanford doctorate). None matches this Charles University 1997 organic chemist teaching at UJEP since 2001. Checked already-proposed.txt; neither her name nor its local-order variants occurs.

coverage.employer: Other European universities outside the other assigned slices
coverage.note: Search-level extension into Greece, Romania, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Slovakia, Lithuania, Estonia and Russian university domains (including ITMO, HSE, St Petersburg and Ural Federal). No new eligible current faculty member was verified on an employer person page. These are discovery screens, not exhaustive institutional audits; no claim of absence is made.

Later-pass discovery used Vietnamese given-name tokens (including Thu, Huong, Huyen, Trang, Thuy, Dung, Hieu, Hai, Minh, Long, Thanh, Phuong, Ngoc, Quang, Duc, Huy, Viet and Phuoc) and less common surnames including Trinh, Quach, Nghiem, Trieu and Ton-That, alongside spelling/order variants. Broad institutional screening across the six core countries and smaller European systems reached diminishing verified yield. Stopped after a well-covered discovery pass with one fully evidenced new candidate, below the 25-candidate cap. Search snippets were used for leads or exclusions only; no candidate rests on a search snippet. No LinkedIn fetched, no login, no GitHub changes, and no roster edits.
